title: German Bundestag Lets Customs Freeze Crypto Over €100,000 Without a Criminal Case as the Bill Goes to the Bundesrat
content: Bitcoin Magazine German Bundestag Lets Customs Freeze Crypto Over €100,000 Without a Criminal Case as the Bill Goes to the Bundesrat The Bundestag approved a bill that would let German customs freeze crypto and other assets over €100,000 of unclear origin without a criminal case. Permanent confiscation would still require a court, and the timing of the Bundesrat vote remains unclear. This post German Bundestag Lets Customs Freeze Crypto Over €100,000 Without a Criminal Case as the Bill Goes to the Bundesrat first appeared on Bitcoin Magazine and is written by Micah Zimmerman .

title: Harvard Holds 3.04 Million Bitcoin ETF Shares Steady
content: Bitcoin Magazine Harvard Holds 3.04 Million Bitcoin ETF Shares Steady Harvard Management Company's latest 13F shows it still holds 3,044,612 shares of BlackRock's iShares Bitcoin Trust, unchanged since March, a stake now worth about $110.6 million after bitcoin's slide. title: Supreme Court Ends Custodia Bank’s Fight for a Fed Master Account, Leaving the Fed Free to Deny Crypto Banks Access
content: Bitcoin Magazine Supreme Court Ends Custodia Bank’s Fight for a Fed Master Account, Leaving the Fed Free to Deny Crypto Banks Access The Supreme Court denied Custodia Bank's petition in No. 26-62 on Monday, leaving in place a Tenth Circuit ruling that Federal Reserve Banks may reject even eligible applicants for master accounts. title: Hong Kong to License Crypto Dealers and Custodians by Year-End
content: Bitcoin Magazine Hong Kong to License Crypto Dealers and Custodians by Year-End Financial Secretary Paul Chan said Hong Kong will introduce a bill by year-end to license crypto dealers, advisers, managers and custodians, after only two of 36 first-round stablecoin applicants received licenses in April.
